name: orc_whr_refprop_cost
title: Waste-heat-recovery ORC with a scroll expander, REFPROP mixtures and an equipment cost model
summary: Complete ORC recovering heat from an exhaust-gas/thermal-oil stream: three-zone plate evaporator and condenser with Thonon/Kuo/Hsieh correlations, scroll expander with fixed volume ratio, pump, pipe sizing and total equipment/investment cost; refrigerant properties as CoolProp calls on the mixture R245fa+R134a (the source uses the EES REFPROP interface; stored run: pure R245fa).

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (386 variables), compared with the runnable _coolsolve variant: 356 common variables; 93 are affected by the corrections of kuo and Hsieh_new (condenser, evaporator area, costs and cycle outputs downstream); the others differ by a few % at most, apart from the air enthalpy reference offset (see README)
verification.notes: max_rel_diff excludes the 93 outputs affected by the corrections (listed in the README). Maximum of the others: 0.252 = absolute air enthalpies h_a_ex_liq (reference-state offset EES ideal gas vs CoolProp Air); excluding that pair, 0.061 on Cp_r_ex_vap_cd (property backend). P_evap (26.18 bar in both files) is not counted: --ees-units scales its bar value by 1e5 (comparison tool artefact). Corrected values: A_cd 8.89 m2 (EES 5.46), W_dot_net 3288 W (3425), eta_cycle 6.65 % (6.96 %), SIC 3288 EUR/kW (2700). Native file not runnable (CS-GAP-END-PROCEDURE; then the undefined local string fluidev$ of hx_cd).
